summary: SRX Global Inc. filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing an October 6 Stock Purchase Agreement to acquire all outstanding capital stock of CERo Therapeutics, Inc., the wholly owned operating subsidiary of CERo Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. Consideration combines $1,000,000 of SRX common stock priced at the lower of the prior-day close or 20-day VWAP, forgiveness of a Consolidated Note with $8,249,643.77 outstanding principal (up to $11,666,108.77 original), plus assumption of roughly $1,562,000 of liabilities. The note maturity extends to five business days after closing or termination. No board recommendation or advisor named; watch financing, closing conditions and note overhang.
